sources.project: GDAL CAD — AutoCAD DWG driver documentation
sources.observation: The CAD driver says its DWG route is based on libopencad, is read-only, and projects POINT, LINE, CIRCLE/ARC, and 3DFACE into OGR geometries. It may tessellate rounded polylines; its documented generic attributes do not promise a stable source-entity handle field.

The driver list separates CAD/AutoCAD DWG with internal libopencad from a DWG driver associated with Open Design Alliance Teigha. The route must be identified by selected driver and backend rather than by input extension or a generic GDAL label.

The DXF driver reads ASCII DXF and writes DXF in the AutoCAD 2004 format; its docs describe compatibility with AutoCAD 2004 and later. Binary DXF input is documented beginning with GDAL 3.12. It projects into OGR features; EntityHandle is available, raw unhandled group values are opt-in, and block inlining is configurable.

3DSOLID, REGION, BODY and SURFACE carriers are skipped by default because GDAL cannot transform them into OGR geometries. Optional DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes ASMData and a 12-real column-major ASMTransform only for AC1027 and later; this is raw carrier/transform exposure, not B-rep semantics.

method.limitations: The review uses mutable current stable documentation rather than a pinned GDAL release binary or source checkout. No driver was executed, so no parser behavior, raw carrier bytes, geometry, or consumer outcome was observed. The findings refine comparator applicability only.
